scripts.build:web: node scripts/build-blog.mjs && expo export --platform web && mv dist/assets/node_modules dist/assets/nm && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const d="dist/_expo/static/js/web";for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d).filter(n=>n.endsWith(".js"))){const q=p.join(d,f);fs.writeFileSync(q,fs.readFileSync(q,"utf8").split("/assets/node_modules/").join("/assets/nm/"))}'
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npx wrangler pages deploy dist/ --project-name guanacaste-experiences --branch main
